messages:
Tara (CS): drafting a short customer-facing playbook for CrescentCo kickoff tomorrow. must-have: prefill/prefetch quick wins, batching knobs, streaming fallback and a renewal-risk telemetry checklist. can ppl sanity-check?
Jon (SRE): short + actionable please. add defaults for small/med/large and a one-line troubleshooting section.
Tara (CS): proposing defaults: small: prefill=100 tokens, batch=8; med: prefill=600, batch=16; large: prefill=1800, batch=28. note: watch cost.
Leah (Solutions): add warm-pool suggestion for first 72h for med/large and a budget cap tag during onboarding.
Marco (CS Ops): for renewal-risk accounts add 14-day probe cadence: daily checks first 7 days, every other day next 7. capture prefix_cache_hit_rate, stream_error_rate, p95_latency, token_delta.
Tara (CS): sample prefill API snippet to include:
POST /v1/prefill
{ "tenant_id": "crescent-prod", "prefill_tokens": 600, "ttl_seconds": 10800 }
Jon (SRE): config note: if max_batch_size > 20 enable adaptive_jitter and burst_smoothing on older hardware.
Leah (Solutions): small YAML example to share with customers:
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 16
  adaptive: true
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_cache_ttl: 3600
streaming:
  fallback_to_sync: true
  max_chunk_delay_ms: 80
Tara (CS): troubleshooting cheat sheet (10min):
- prefill ignored -> check TTL and prompt variance
- low cache hit -> increase TTL or reduce variance
- rise in p95 -> reduce max_batch_size or add warm pool
redwood-notify-bot: reminder: infra deploy 2024-12-05 02:00 UTC may slow warm-pool spin-ups.
Tara (CS): I'll produce a one-pager and paste-in checklist for support tickets. tagging @Leah for final config review. :thumbsup:
